stemMd: Which pair supplies energy and reducing power to carbon fixation in the Calvin cycle?
explanationMd: The light-dependent reactions generate ATP and NADPH. The Calvin cycle uses ATP to drive reactions and NADPH to reduce carbon compounds; distinguish energy transfer from electron donation.

distractorRationale.a: These are lower-energy or oxidised products, not the supplied pair.
distractorRationale.d: Pepsin is a digestive enzyme and glycogen a storage polymer.
distractorRationale.b: These are not the immediate energy and reducing cofactors.
distractorRationale.c: Neither supplies the usual Calvin-cycle energy pair.
